answer_1.quote: Satirical Image Understanding -Given a satirical image, describing in natural language why the image is satirical
answer_1.outputs: natural language descriptions of why an image is satirical

answer_2.quote: standard metrics for automatic evaluation of text generation-based tasks - lexical overlap metrics such as BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR, and semantic similarity metrics such as BERTScore

answer_4.quote: we randomly sample 30 images ... along with their model-generated and human-written overall image descriptions. Each image description is human-evaluated based on the following (binary) criteria ... The annotation is carried out by 3 students in the lab, and the majority vote is taken for each image.
answer_4.guideline: Correctness: Is the image description correctly able to convey the satire the image wanted to convey? (2) Appropriate Length: Is the image description length appropriate for conveying the meaning (i.e. it is not too verbose)? (3) Visual Completeness: Does the image description describe all the important elements in the image? (4) Faithfulness: Are all the elements of the image description supported by either the visual or text elements (i.e. there are no madeup elements)?
